turns.question: What is the railway initiative?
turns.answer: The Sustainable Solutions Lab (SSL) is collaborating with the Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT), UMass Boston, and AECOM experts on the Cape Cod Rail Resilience Research Project [1]. This initiative is led by Carlos Velásquez, a PhD candidate at UMass Boston and project manager at MassDOT [1]. The project aims to improve rail safety and climate resilience along the Cape Main Line by integrating stakeholder-engaged research methods with advanced technology [1]. The initiative was launched in response to a 300-foot rail embankment collapse in East Sandwich in 2020, which was linked to climate change-induced drought conditions [1]. Utilizing funding from the United States Department of Transportation (USDOT), the team employs aerial surveys, hydrological drought analysis, and real-time monitoring systems, including drones for mapping and sensors for water level monitoring, at three pilot study sites [1].
